title: AIX must turn on SSH daemon reverse name checking.
check_content:
Check the SSH daemon configuration for the "VerifyReverseMapping" setting using command: 

# grep -i VerifyReverseMapping  /etc/ssh/sshd_config | grep -v '^#' 
VerifyReverseMapping yes

If the setting is not present or the setting is "no", this is a finding.
fixtext:
Edit the "/etc/sshd/sshd_config" file and add the following line:
VerifyReverseMapping yes

Restart the SSH daemon:
# stopsrc -s sshd
# startsrc -s sshd
VulnDiscussion: If reverse name checking is off, SSH may allow a remote attacker to circumvent security policies and attempt to or actually login from IP addresses that are not permitted to access resources.
